summary: Implementation plan for the Busy Bees Expense Tracker Logo System featuring Concept 1 (Animated Bee swooping through the Indian Rupee ₹ symbol) as the primary brand mark, while preserving Concept 2 (Geometric Bee + ₹ Honeycomb Monogram) and Concept 3 (3D Mascot Bee & Gold ₹ Coin) for secondary uses and an interactive Brand Gallery. Covers animated rendering on the Splash and Welcome screens, crisp static rendering in the Top Header, Navigation Drawer, PDF Report Header/Preview, and Android Launcher Icon.
